parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the VPN gateway is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RouteEntryType
parameters.description:
The type of the route entry. Valid values:

*   **Custom**: custom
*   **System**: system

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPN gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1cmw7jh1nfe43m90000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --route-entry-type custom --region cn-hangzhou
